summary: Added typed regular-expression capture rows with stable group identity, participation state, text and exact byte/UTF-16 spans. Captures are explicitly projectable and expandable without changing occurrence cardinality, while the selected portable non-backtracking profile's repeated-group behavior remains explicit and bounded.

review.reviewer: separate grill-code review pass (no independent subagent was available)

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search source, tests, Search documentation and W07-S03 evidence were changed. The ignored local campaign state was not staged. No sibling repository, SQL/XML surface, release, publication or installation was modified.
implementation.captureModel: Captures expose GroupName, GroupIndex, CaptureIndex, Success, Text, ByteOffset, ByteLength, Utf16Column and Utf16Length. Group zero is omitted; unnamed groups use null names; unmatched groups use false/null placeholders; successful empty captures use true/empty zero-length values.
implementation.repeatedGroupPolicy: The selected portable-nonbacktracking-v1 profile exposes the final successful capture for a repeated group with CaptureIndex zero. Accepted duplicate names share the engine group number. No silent backtracking fallback is used.
implementation.projectionIntegration: The typed Captures collection is a schema property and is explicitly expandable with CROSS APPLY. Capture objects are materialized only when Captures is requested, while literal and compact rows retain a shared empty collection and unchanged occurrence cardinality.
implementation.coordinatePolicy: Capture byte ranges reuse the existing lossless decoder coordinate mapping; UTF-16 positions are relative to the containing physical record and remain nullable when a byte mapping cannot be proven.

gateResults.evidence: The exact owning-repository Release suite exited 0 with 21 projects, 1,442 discovered, 1,408 passed, 0 failed and 34 expected skips; the focused Search suite exited 0 with 158 discovered, 155 passed, 0 failed and 3 expected platform-conditional skips.

The separate ownership review approved typed capture identity, missing-versus-empty semantics, projection-aware materialization, safe-profile repeated-group behavior and coordinate mapping; exact commands, tool versions, source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are recorded and verified during post-commit finalization.

Focused tests cover optional unmatched groups, successful empty groups, multiple groups, repeated groups, duplicate names, projection elision, CROSS APPLY schema expansion and UTF-8/UTF-16 capture coordinates.
Captures are a stable typed collection property; no pattern-dependent top-level columns, public SQL/XML constructor or sibling-repository contract was invented.

Capture metadata is computed once per file only for requested capture projections, each match returns bounded typed rows, immutable collections prevent scanner-state exposure, and existing cancellation/resource/error paths remain intact.

knownLimitations: The selected portable non-backtracking profile intentionally exposes only the final successful capture for repeated groups; backtracking capture history remains a separately gated future profile.
The regex request mode is an internal foundation and this scope does not add a public SQL/XML regex constructor or many-pattern transport.
Literal matches and compact projections expose an empty Captures collection; capture data is materialized only when requested or when direct callers provide no projection metadata.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 existing expected skips and 3 platform-conditional symlink skips; no package was published, pushed, released or installed.
